name: clustering
description: Decide how many clusters K of residues share global parameters in multi-residue global fits.

interface.longDescription: Choose K, memberships, and shared parameter values for multi-residue global fits using reduced chi-squared, AICc, jackknife stability, and outlier diagnostics.
